extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia readers and prospective editors attempting to create a new article
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and procedural requirements for creating a new Wikipedia page (checking for existing pages, account requirements, title conventions, and troubleshooting missing pages).

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmation required to create new articles
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you don't meet these requirements, use alternatives such as the article wizard to submit a draft for review or request a new article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or submit a draft for review
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is offered as a path for users who cannot directly create a new page (e.g., not autoconfirmed) or who prefer guidance through the creation process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for existing articles or alternative titles/spellings first
rubrics_metrics.description: Please search for 'Robert Smigel book' in existing articles to check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a new page, verify whether the topic already exists under a different name or spelling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Look for pages that link to the intended title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Checking incoming links can reveal redirects or existing coverage of the subject that make a new page unnecessary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Newly created pages may be temporarily invisible; try purge/wait
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Wait a few minutes or try the purge function to see recently created pages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Titles are case-sensitive (except first character); consider redirects
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure correct capitalization and add redirects when appropriate so readers can find the article under variant spellings/capitalizations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check the deletion log if a page has been deleted
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Review the deletion log and relevant help pages to understand deletion reasons and whether the topic can be reworked to meet Wikipedia's standards.
